name: Shurvana AI Review insights for WooCommerce
author: shurvana

sections.description:
Shurvana AI Review insights for WooCommerce uses advanced AI to analyze product reviews, providing merchants with actionable insights, sentiment analysis, and detection of common product issues. Instantly understand what customers love or dislike, track sentiment trends, and improve your products based on real feedback. The plugin features a user-friendly dashboard, product selection for targeted analysis, and seamless integration with WooCommerce.

Key Features:

  • AI-powered analysis of WooCommerce product reviews
  • Sentiment scoring and summary generation
  • Detection of common issues and keywords
  • Interactive dashboard for visual insights
  • Product selection dropdown for targeted review analysis
  • Easy API key management (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini)
  • AJAX-powered test tool for instant review analysis
  • Secure uninstall: removes all plugin data and options

SEO Benefits:
* Improve product quality and customer satisfaction
* Identify and address negative feedback quickly
* Boost store reputation and conversion rates

Upcoming Features:

  • Multi-language review analysis
  • Advanced analytics and reporting
  • Export insights to CSV/Excel
  • Automated review moderation suggestions
  • Integration with email and notification systems
  • Customizable AI prompts and models
  • REST API endpoints for external integrations

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party AI services to generate review insights and analysis.

This plugin uses the Google Generative Language API (Gemini) to analyze product reviews and generate AI-based summaries and sentiment insights.

Selected Product’s Reviews and related prompt data are sent to the API only when an administrator manually initiates AI analysis. No data is sent automatically.

This service is provided by Google LLC:
Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms

Usage Policies: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/usage-policies

Available Regions: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/available-regions
sections.installation:
1. Upload shurvana-ai-review-insights-for-woocommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to “AI Review Insights” in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Enter your AI API key and select a product for review analysis
  5. Use the dashboard and test tool to view insights
sections.faq:
What AI models are supported?

OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini models are supported. Enter your API key in the settings.

Does this plugin store customer data?

No, only review insights and analysis results are stored. All data is removed on uninstall.

Can I analyze reviews for specific products?

Yes, use the product dropdown in the settings to select which product to analyze.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No, all analysis is performed asynchronously and results are cached in the database.
